judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Breathless exclamation-heavy plea, a missing comma after the appositive, the clumsy 'Oh why aren't you going?' and the light joke about the menfolk who cannot live without them all read like Westwood's quick, unpolished side-quest writing; the plain journal line fits too. Nothing in it sounds too careful or modern.
